tomeofblood.glyph_desc.glyph_sentient_ha: Consumes Spiritus to attack your target. Damage scales with the Spiritus you carry, and the target drops Spiritus when killed. With Extend Time, it applies an effect based on your Spiritus type instead: Raw causes Poison, Ruina causes Wither, Vindicta causes Weakness, Invictus causes Slowness and Nihilum causes Vulnerable.
tomeofblood.glyph_desc.glyph_sentient_wr: Marks a target on the first hit. Attacking a marked target does a heavy attack that scales with your Spiritus, hits everything in a radius and marks them all. Consumes Spiritus. Killing a target grants a bonus unless you are using Raw Spiritus: Ruina grants Resistance, Vindicta grants Speed, Invictus grants Absorption and Nihilum grants Spell Damage.
